title: Class-marked charm/Envoy options sometimes do nothing mechanically: 'turn your best charm on him (as an Envoy)' on the hunter and 'turn on the charm (Envoy)' on Old Crick both cost a turn and are explicitly rebuffed by the NPC ('Whatever that charm buys, it isn't his patience'), yielding only 1xp, with no way to know beforehand it would whiff — unlike most other Envoy options (e.g. haggling Cal's debt, Maud's hut, negotiating with the Regent) which are reliably strong.
where: Hunter's Camp (talk to hunter) and Cinderhall Miners' Hall (talk to Old Crick)
